data.gender_notes: Mawjudah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-j-d', meaning 'to exist', 'to be present'. This name evokes a sense of spiritual reality and divine presence. The name Mawjudah carries the meaning “Existent, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawjudah usually hope their child will grow to embody existent, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.
